verdict.rationale: E2B's own docs state that agent code runs in an isolated Firecracker microVM rather than on your server. The GitHub repo and other doc pages describe secure isolated sandboxes, and outbound network access can be restricted. Missing for 10: a dedicated security/isolation architecture document (the microVM claim appears only on an integration page), detail on the guest/host boundary and threat model, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation.
